extraction.name: CoNLL-2003 Shared Task: Language-Independent Named Entity Recognition
extraction.description: Data sets for the CoNLL-2003 shared task concerning language-independent named entity recognition, providing training, development, and test data for English and German.
extraction.creator: Erik F. Tjong Kim Sang and Fien De Meulder
extraction.publisher: CNTS - Language Technology Group, University of Antwerp
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The English data was taken from the Reuters Corpus. The text for the German data was taken from the ECI Multilingual Text Corpus, specifically extracted from the German newspaper Frankfurter Rundshau.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Reuters news stories for the English data and articles from the German newspaper Frankfurter Rundshau (via the ECI Multilingual Text Corpus) for the German data.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: English data: August 1996 to August 1997. German data: August 1992 to December 1992.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A tokenizer, part-of-speech tagger, and a chunker were applied to the raw data. The English data was tagged and chunked by the memory-based MBT tagger. The German data was lemmatized, tagged and chunked by the decision tree tagger Treetagger.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Named entity tagging of English and German training, development, and test data was done by hand at the University of Antwerp. MUC conventions were mostly followed, with an extra named entity category called MISC added. The IOB tagging scheme was used, assuming named entities are non-recursive and non-overlapping.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Development (tuning parameters), and Testing of machine learning components for named entity recognition.
